name: Mavenlink (now Kantata OX)
description: Mavenlink is the former name of Kantata OX, a professional-services automation platform for managing projects, resources, finances and team collaboration. Professional-services organizations use the current Kantata OX product to plan delivery, allocate people, track time and expenses, collaborate on work and understand project performance.
agentUseSummary: Mavenlink is not a separate Relay account provider. It is the legacy name and retained API hostname for Kantata OX, so connection state, OAuth tokens, permissions, runtime actions, revocation and audit must resolve to the canonical Kantata OX provider instead of being duplicated.

blocked.label: Connect Mavenlink separately
blocked.description: Mavenlink and Kantata OX are the same product and account authority; there is no second tenant, OAuth application, token or revocation lifecycle to connect.

blocked.label: Mount duplicate Mavenlink tools
blocked.description: The canonical Kantata OX connector must own supported professional-services tools, approval policy, bounds, redaction and audit records once.

blocked.label: Split Mavenlink and Kantata origins
blocked.description: Kantata OX retains Mavenlink application and API hostnames; those routes cannot create a second provider identity or fallback authority.

blocked.label: Bypass Kantata OX permissions
blocked.description: API actions inherit the canonical Kantata OX user's account and project permissions; a legacy label cannot weaken them.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary legacy API calls
blocked.description: No raw Mavenlink or Kantata OX REST surface is mounted through this alias.

approvalProfiles.label: Use Kantata OX
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Mavenlink actions are enabled. Connect the canonical Kantata OX provider and apply its selected capabilities, account binding and install policy.

runtimeSupport.description: No separate Mavenlink tools are mounted; OpenClaw must use the canonical Kantata OX connector for supported account-bound actions.
No separate Mavenlink tools are mounted; Hermes must use the canonical Kantata OX connector for supported account-bound actions.

providerSetup.blocker: Kantata officially identifies Mavenlink as the former name of Kantata OX. The current Kantata OX API continues to use Mavenlink application and API hostnames and one account-registered OAuth bearer-token lifecycle. Publishing Mavenlink separately would duplicate connection state, credentials, agent selection, permission policy, revocation, disconnect and audit semantics for one account.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not show a separate Mavenlink Connect action or request another OAuth application or token. Implement and validate one canonical Kantata OX connection, preserve Mavenlink as a discovery alias, and route supported legacy-name references through the canonical provider's exact account, credentials, capabilities and policy.

evidence.supports: Kantata's official product page states that Mavenlink is now Kantata and specifically identifies Mavenlink as Kantata OX after the Mavenlink and Kimble merger.
Kantata's current API overview identifies the product as Kantata OX while documenting the retained api.mavenlink.com REST origin and one account application and OAuth-token lifecycle.
Official registration guidance requires one Kantata OX account application and Kantata-generated OAuth bearer token and documents application deletion as token invalidation.
Kantata's current customer resources label Kantata OX as formerly Mavenlink, confirming one continuous product identity.
